detail.overview: Intex SA14BDPT | 14 kg Semi-Automatic Washing Machine The Intex SA14BDPT 14 KG washing machine is made for heavy-duty laundry tasks with its large capacity and durable anti-corrosive body. Designed for efficient washing, it features a 5-roller pulsator, salt water compatibility, and rubber vibration pads. It offers user-friendly features like an in-built detergent box, dual waterfall, and dual magic filters. The air dry window ensures faster drying while keeping spinning noise to a minimum. Ideal for families looking for power, performance, and value.
